sections.Profile:
"Landing on Venus" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1965. Designed for single-player gameplay, it features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and three standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Space, Original Theme, Fantasy
